messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: `gpu.kv_cache.alloc_failure` on pool `gpu-pool-west2` (sev=high). 10 distinct alloc failures in 60s. Sample: `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY`

pagerduty: PagerDuty incident #PD-48721 opened — escalation policy: gpu-oncall -> sre-rotate. Link: https://pd.example/PD-48721

ash_oncall: Acked the PD. I'm on it. pulling logs now.

liam_ml_oncall: Seeing big KV cache evictions on the model-serving hosts — eviction/sec spiked from ~0 to 420. Could be prefetch or a regressed model config.

ash_oncall: Quick check: `ssh node-gpu-03` -> `dmesg | tail -n 50` shows repeated `cuda: alloc failed` lines. Also GPU mem usage at 98% on node-gpu-03.

liam_ml_oncall: Paste from metrics:```evictions_total{pool="gpu-pool-west2"} 3240
alloc_failures{pool="gpu-pool-west2"} 12
gpu_mem_util{node="node-gpu-03"} 0.98```

maya_infra: Noted. If it's KV thrash we should drain new requests off this pool and enable fallback routing to `gpu-pool-west2-degen` (smaller batch / quantized). Initiating drain on pool.

ash_oncall: Running drain: `routedrain --pool gpu-pool-west2 --mode immediate` -> applied. Confirming in router logs... 5s

rohit_sre: I'll start a rolling reboot of the worst hosts after drain if they remain unhealthy. Before that: can we reduce batch_size at the proxy level to 1 for affected models? That might reduce pressure instantly.

liam_ml_oncall: Agreed. Decreasing inference batch_size for model-family rl-chat-v2 on west2 route: `redwoodctl routes patch --route /infer/rl-chat-v2 --batch-size 1 --region west2`

ash_oncall: Batch size change applied. Also toggled prefix caching off for the route to avoid extra KV churn: `redwoodctl routes patch --route /infer/rl-chat-v2 --prefix-cache false`

maya_infra: Router confirms >90% traffic now rerouted to `gpu-pool-west2-degen` and fallback. Pool `gpu-pool-west2` active connections dropping.

evan_csm: Heads up — customer telemetry shows increased error rate for customer_acme and customer_orbit since 14:02 UTC. Estimated impact: 3-5% of requests failed or timed out. I've pinged their SRE contact and opened a support note.

ash_oncall: Running healthcheck on node-gpu-03: `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used,memory.total --format=csv` -> shows 15930 MiB / 16384 MiB. Very near full.

rohit_sre: Ok plan: 1) keep pool drained 2) continue fallback routing 3) reboot unhealthy hosts after traffic clears 4) run kvcache diagnostic job to capture prefetch traces. I'll own the host reboots.

liam_ml_oncall: I'll add a temporary model pin to quantized variant for traffic routed to degen: `routes pin --route /infer/rl-chat-v2 --model rl-chat-v2-quant-8bit --duration 2h` to reduce mem footprint.

ash_oncall: Pin applied. Observability: alloc_failures dropped from ~12/min to 0 after reroute and batch_size change, eviction/sec back to ~15.

maya_infra: Reboot started on node-gpu-03 (rebooting to clear potential driver fragmentation). ETA 4m.

rohit_sre: Noted. I'll monitor cuda driver logs while reboot happens. If reboots don't improve, escalate to infra-bless for kernel/driver patch.

evan_csm: Customer update sent: "We observed transient GPU memory pressure causing a subset of inference requests to fail between 14:02-14:18 UTC. We've rerouted traffic to fallback capacity and applied mitigations. We're investigating root cause and will share follow-up."

ash_oncall: node-gpu-03 back online. Post-reboot `nvidia-smi` shows memory clean. Re-adding node to pool in warm mode.

maya_infra: Warm add complete. Pool `gpu-pool-west2` at 70% capacity now, alloc_failures=0 for 6m.

liam_ml_oncall: Follow-up: I pushed a change to reduce prefetch window on the offending model (limits KV prefetch depth to 4). Deployed as canary to 10% traffic.

rohit_sre: I'll keep the PD incident open for another 30m for observation, then hand to post-incident for RCA. If anyone needs to take over, ping me.

ash_oncall: Handing incident to rohit for stabilization and post-mortem. I'm signing off the on-call rotation now. :thumbsup:

rohit_sre: Acknowledged handoff. I'll create an incident ticket and collect traces. Runbook referenced: https://playbooks.redwood/gpu-memory-oom.

incident-bot: Incident note appended to PD-48721: mitigations applied (drain, batch size ->1, prefix cache off, model pin to quant variant, node reboot). Monitoring for 30m.

pagerduty: PagerDuty update: incident status -> acknowledged, responders: ash_oncall, liam_ml_oncall, maya_infra, rohit_sre.

rohit_sre: Closing timeline entry. Next steps: RCA (driver frag vs prefetch regression), write-up, customer impact summary, and potential rollout of prefetch guard. I'll assign tasks after 30m observation.
